newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Fertiberia ups bid for Sefanitro.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Fertiberia ups bid for Sefanitro.

text.p: Spanish fertiliser group Fertiberia has increased its initial offer for chemicals firm Sefanitro to 630 pesetas per share, Spain's stock market commission said on Friday.
The increased offer comes a day after the CNMV authorised a counterbid made by a group of minority shareholders and Norsk Hydro for 100 percent of Sefanitro's shares at 600 pesetas per share.

"Fertiberia has modified the conditions of its bid, and has improved the offer price to five percent above that offered by the competitive bid, that is 630 pesetas per share," the CNMV said in a press statement.
An initial bid was made by Fertiberia for Sefanitro in October.

Thursday's counterbid was made by Norsk Hydro's fertiliser subsidiary Hydro Agri Espana and minority shareholders Berzeluis Felguera SA, Vicinay Cadenas SA, V.A.J. Investments, Jose Maria de la Iglesia and Carlos Castellanos.
Sefanitro shares were suspended on November 12 after the CNMV received the competitive offer for the firm. Shares were trading at 625 pesetas prior to the suspension.
